description: Source code for a utility script 'makefont.php' used to generate font definition files for TCPDF, handling font files (TTF, OTF, PFB), encoding maps, and font metrics. It includes functions for reading font metrics, encoding, compressing font files, and generating PHP scripts defining font properties.

methods.name: MakeFont
methods.description: Main function to generate a font definition PHP file from font and metrics files, embedding the font data, and handling font encoding and metrics.

methods.name: ReadMap
methods.description: Reads an encoding map file from the 'enc' directory and returns an array mapping character codes to glyph names.

methods.name: ReadUFM
methods.description: Reads a UFM font metric file, extracts widths and glyph mappings, and prepares font metadata.

methods.name: ReadAFM
methods.description: Reads an AFM font metric file, extracts widths, font info, and builds encoding maps.

methods.name: MakeFontDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a descriptor array for a font from its metrics, including ascent, descent, flags, and font bounding box.

methods.name: MakeWidthArray
methods.description: Creates a PHP array string defining character widths from font metrics.

methods.name: MakeFontEncoding
methods.description: Builds the differences string from a font's character map compared to a reference encoding.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: ReadShort
methods.description: Reads a 2-byte unsigned short from a binary font file.

methods.name: ReadLong
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte unsigned long from a binary font file.

methods.name: CheckTTF
methods.description: Checks if a TrueType font file allows embedding based on its license bits.
